Zoe M: heads-up: publishflow blocked when landing sample-sdk. regen-check shows a tiny typegen diff that looks like union ordering only.

Rafael G: paste?

Zoe M: snippet:
```diff
- export type Color = "red" | "blue";
+ export type Color = "blue" | "red";
```
No shape change but changelog-gen suggested minor.

CI Bot: regen-check failed on runner: ubuntu-22.04-9; diff in packages/sdk/src/types/colors.ts; publishguard: blocked

Rafael G: another pain point: sample-app tests snapshot the generated file raw. They fail on text diffs even if semantically identical.

Zoe M: plan: 1) quick PR to change snapshots to parse and compare sets (PR#5001) to unblock, 2) add a stable canonical sort pass in typegen generator and CI unit (PR#5002), 3) teach changelog-gen to run AST comparator that ignores union/property order (follow-up ticket).

Rafael G: sounds good. Also noticed an unrelated auth/retry flake in the CI matrix (one job had a 401 that wasn't retried). Might be test harness reading env after module load.

Zoe M: repro steps for retry flake: run integration matrix in docker variant; sometimes AUTH_RETRIES isn't present at module eval time. Quick fix: set env in wrapper before node runs, or make auth module read config at runtime.

ops-bot: manual override policy: allowed if PR#5001 merged and follow-up ticket created.

CI Bot: publishflow guard: still blocked -> awaiting human review.

Rafael G: I'll open PRs and a changelog ticket, ping release-oncall once PR#5001 merges. Also will add a short DevEx doc "Autogen types: semver guidance" so SDK authors know ordering-only diffs are patch.
